> ingestion pipelines, platforms, and the infrastructure underneath. Open to full-time
> roles in distributed systems, data infrastructure, platform, and DevOps.

## Projects

Selected work, newest first. Source code is on GitHub.

- [PRISM](https://github.com/jasowills/prism): Payment reconciliation that turns four disagreeing signals into explainable findings.
- [TIDE](https://github.com/jasowills/TIDE): Telematics infrastructure, from raw vehicle signals to state, events and actions. Go, NATS JetStream, PostgreSQL with PostGIS.
- [TRACE](https://github.com/jasowills/TRACE): An MCP server that follows synthetic events through an ingestion pipeline and proves where they went wrong. TypeScript, MCP SDK, Redis Streams, PostgreSQL.
- [Pulse](https://github.com/jasowills/pulse): Typed, live change feeds from your database to your clients, on .NET. C#, SignalR.
- [Sonar](https://github.com/jasowills/watchDog): Observability with AI root cause analysis and a public status page. Live at https://sonar-dev.vercel.app.
